title: Bucket
description: Though the Astromech Droid's designation was R1-J5, everyone referred to him as Bucket. That was because the old Droid has seen his share of wear and tear, frequently experiencing glitches due to his outdated programming. Bucket belonged to Jarek Yeager, serving him as a mechanic. Though the Droid has an array of mechanical problems, he has no problem being a mechanic.
